assertions.name: rmatrix_reproduces_T17_chi_21
assertions.source: The independent R-matrix derivation of χ^(2,1)(β_Bor) must reproduce T17 (PR #1933): 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶ to all orders ≤ h⁶. Cross-validates T17 and confirms the catalogue's first derived cell.

assertions.name: chi_trivial_is_unity
assertions.source: χ^(3)(β_Bor) from trivial Hecke rep (σ_i → q, σ_i⁻¹ → q⁻¹) evaluated on (σ_1⁻¹σ_2)^3 is q⁻¹·q·q⁻¹·q·q⁻¹·q = 1 exactly.

assertions.name: chi_sign_is_unity
assertions.source: χ^(1,1,1)(β_Bor) from sign Hecke rep (σ_i → −q⁻¹, σ_i⁻¹ → −q) evaluated on (σ_1⁻¹σ_2)^3 is ((−q)·(−q⁻¹))^3 = 1 exactly.

description: Phase 1 of the 3-axis (knot, partition, atom) derived-χ catalogue. Emits the first three Borromean cells via R-matrix on V⊗³ (matches T17 / PR #1933 conventions) plus the (3) and (1,1,1) blocks from the 1-dim Hecke reps. Independent re-derivation; cross-validates T17.

cells.notes: χ^(3)(β_Bor) = 1 exactly (q-independent), from the 1-dim trivial Hecke rep.
